facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: A child saw the truth. He shouted it out. People started to agree. A child told the truth.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: While all the adults pretended, a small child spoke up. The child shouted that the emperor was wearing nothing. A child told the truth that everyone was afraid to say. The crowd became quiet, then started whispering. One by one, people agreed with the brave child. The truth spread through the crowd like wildfire.
facts.Word cards: child = 아이 / told = 말했다 / truth = 진실 / emperor = 임금님
